_meta.note: Reconciled against contract/api-contract.json by tests/Feature/Plugins/ModuleContractReconciliationTest.php — no (method, path) pair may appear in both files. Routes below are the journal-correction endpoints (plan.md 'API-Vertrag') and the budget endpoints (plan.md Etappe 8); route names match routes/api.php exactly.

routes.name: api.accountant-api.journal-entries.corrections.store
routes.notes: Prepares a guided correction: creates a locked reversal draft and an editable replacement draft from the original. Requires Idempotency-Key.

routes.name: api.accountant-api.journal-corrections.show
routes.notes: Returns the correction with original/reversal/replacement and their relationship links.

routes.name: api.accountant-api.journal-corrections.replacement.update
routes.notes: Edits only the replacement draft. Requires Idempotency-Key.

routes.name: api.accountant-api.journal-corrections.post
routes.notes: Posts the reversal and replacement together, atomically. Requires Idempotency-Key.

routes.name: api.accountant-api.journal-corrections.destroy
routes.notes: Discards an open (draft) correction. Only allowed while status is draft.

routes.name: api.accountant-api.budgets.index
routes.notes: Monthly budget targets of the organization. Optional fiscal_year filter, paginated (max 100 per page). Requires feature:budgets.

routes.name: api.accountant-api.budgets.show
routes.notes: A single budget, addressed by its natural key. 404 when the code is unknown or inactive, or no target is set for that year.

routes.name: api.accountant-api.budgets.put
routes.notes: Upsert: 201 when the target is new, 200 when it replaces an existing one. Idempotent by construction (natural key), therefore deliberately not run through HandleApiIdempotency and requiring no Idempotency-Key.

routes.name: api.accountant-api.budgets.destroy
routes.notes: Removes a budget target. 204 on success, 404 when nothing is set.
